name: Blue's Birthday
summary: Steve, Tickety, Slippery, and all of Blue's Friends need help preparing for Blue's birthday party! There's so much to do. Create a personalized card for Blue, select a special present play lots of multi-level learning games, explore in and around Blue's house and yard...and of course, find and solve NEW Blue's Clues. Help Steve figure out what party favor Blue wants to give to her guests, what she wants to eat, and more. With so much to explore, create, play and solve, every day can be a birthday celebration in this original adventure.
